title: A chain passes QA only after its verified final write
steps: Run wo-chain-progress.test.mjs against isolated PostgreSQL. Finish base provisioning with missing, failed, stopped or unmeasured content work; also finish a fallback with a verified final write.
expect: Missing or unsuccessful final writes fail the action with QA_NEEDS_REVIEW and qa.state failed.
A final write with a passed Site check can complete after an earlier model failure, with humanAccepted false.
The failed attempt retains its build identity, site identity and original chain findings.
fence: Step-chain demo runner requires an applied brief, terminal chain measurement and final write outcome done.

tests: a soft-failed model step can hand over when the final write and site check passed
a chain with missing brief never passes QA after base provisioning
a chain with failed final write never passes QA after base provisioning
